notes: Approved MVP gates: 18 paired periods, 0.90 paired coverage, 45-day generation recency, MAE at most NTD 15 per tai-jin, RMSE at most NTD 22 per tai-jin, 36-hour wholesale freshness, and 62-day calibration artifact lifetime. Interval and confidence outputs remain disabled, and every model family requires its own fit and backtest evidence.
